description.text:
One of the two expansions that opened the Pokémon Card Game Scarlet & Violet series on 20 January 2023, released together with Violet ex, with the first cards of many Pokémon of the Paldea region. The legendary Koraidon ex leads it: its Ability attaches up to two basic Fighting Energy from the discard pile to its player's Fighting Basic Pokémon. Gardevoir ex, whose Ability attaches basic Psychic Energy from the discard pile to its player's Psychic Pokémon as often as its player likes, Great Tusk ex and the Tera Pokémon Gyarados ex join it, with the Supporters Jacq and Penny. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 78, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and gold Ultra Rare Koraidon ex, Nest Ball and basic Fighting Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Scarlet & Violet in March 2023.

The Scarlet & Violet series brought back Pokémon ex, now written in lower case: Basic or Evolution Pokémon with high HP and strong attacks or Abilities, which give up two Prize cards when Knocked Out. Tera Pokémon ex, drawn in their Terastallized form, take no damage from attacks while on the Bench. From this series Art Rare and Special Art Rare became standing rarities, and Hyper Rare was dropped.
